findings.decision_broken: the tier profile does not declare an edge the architecture prescribes, so allowed traffic alerts (platform gap)
findings.observed: Unexpected ingress network communication from: 10.42.2.159:8443 using TCP to: api x4700 [edge=['frontend', 'backend'], peer_ip=10.42.2.159, peer_port=8443]
findings.fix: platform: declare the inter-tier edge (podSelector app.kubernetes.io/tier) in the tier profile egress/ingress (bobctl)

adrs.title: Workloads run as non-root
adrs.proof: ✓ containers' securityContext read from the pod spec: 2 | ✓ kubescape scan supplied (insecure capabilities / host namespaces): 1 | findings: 5 counted, 0 discounted

findings.decision_broken: the container used a Linux capability, i.e. it starts as root and drops
findings.observed: Unexpected capability used: CAP_SYS_ADMIN in syscall read with PID 428114 [capability=CAP_SYS_ADMIN, process=runc:[1:CHILD]]
findings.fix: switch to the rootless/distroless image variant; this is an image choice, not a profile gap
